summary: Identifies the documented protective earth connection of the selected carrier coupling assembly.
description: Identifies the documented protective earth connection of the selected carrier coupling assembly. A protection communication interface carries information between circuit ends or couples a communication signal to a primary line. Its signal path is different from the power-current path even when both use part of the same installation.

In a switchyard line bay, carrier-coupling equipment can connect a protection communication terminal to the transmission conductor. Fiber-based protection uses another physical path but still needs named endpoints and channel supervision. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Coupling assembly earth terminal” at the input and “Station earth connection” at the output. The earth interface is not a primary switching permission.
